info.name: Get top counterparties for an address

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'base,bsc'). If omitted, returns counterparties across all supported chains.

params.name: flow
params.description: Transfer direction. Only "in" or "out" are accepted (omit for both directions).

params.name: tokens
params.description: Comma-separated list of token addresses or token IDs; matches counterparties involving any of them.

params.name: timeGte
params.description: Filter to activity after this time. Accepts RFC 3339, Unix seconds/ms, or YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: timeLte
params.description: Filter to activity before this time. Accepts RFC 3339, Unix seconds/ms, or YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: timeLast
params.description: Filter to activity within this duration before now (e.g. 24h, 7d). Cannot be combined with timeGte/timeLte.

params.name: usdGte
params.description: Filter to counterparties whose aggregated USD volume is at least this value.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 20. Max: 1000.

params.name: tags
params.description: List of counterparty tags to filter by.

params.name: address
params.description: The address to query counterparties for. A comma-separated list is also accepted — their counterparties are aggregated (per-counterparty volume summed across the listed addresses).

items.docs:
Returns aggregated counterparty activity by volume for the specified address.

Supports filtering by transfer direction, chain, token, time range, and minimum USD volume.

**Rate Limit**: This endpoint has a stricter rate limit of 1 request per second.
